newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel diffs gain modestly, few trades seen.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel diffs gain modestly, few trades seen.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel differentials firmed modestly Friday as sellers attempted to boost offer levels.
However, buyers appeared to reluctant to bite at the higher prices, and traders said few, if any, barrels changed hands.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures slipped about 0.60 cents to sit at 55.25 cents a gallon.
Prompt 54-grade jet fuel in the U.S. Gulf was talked between 0.85 and 0.95 cent over the September futures.
Traders cited firmness in New York Harbor as a key reason for the Gulf move, with prompt barrels in NYH put near 3.30 cents over the September futures, a gain of about 0.15 cent on the day.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
